name: AMB-1
intro: A generative ambient machine after Eno's Music for Airports: it plays itself from power-on. You don't perform it, you tend it: turn PRESETS for another piece, and press keys to change the scale.

rows.what: Previous or next page (seven pages).
The four values at the bottom of the screen.
Garden page: tempo, evolve, motion, drift.
Grow or rest. Resting, the sound fades out slowly.
Any key: add that note to the scale, or take it out.
Mode: Ionian, Dorian ... pentatonic major and minor.
Next chord, at the start of the next bar.
Freeze: the chord holds, the reverb rings on. Again: thaw.
Bells an octave down. OCT+ goes up (two each way).
Set the tempo (30-120), from any page.
Pad: level, swell, bright, colour.
Pad colour: Rhodes or sung voices.
Bells: level, density, tone, octave.
Bass: level, octave, glide, fifth.
Pulse: level, hits, swing, hats. Hits at 0: no pulse.
Evolve: how restless. At 0 the loops repeat exactly.
Motion: how far the slow tide and the echo wander.
Drift: how long a chord lasts, 20 s to 5 min.
Echo: how much goes to the tape echo.
Echo time: dotted quarter up to 4 bars.
Reverb: how much goes to the plate.
Size: room to long hall, and more echo repeats.
Load another of the eight pieces, as you left it.
Save all eight pieces now, even while playing.
After 1.5 s: this piece back to its recipe (not saved yet).
Root note of the key; the scale moves with it.
Fine tune, plus or minus 50 cents.
MIDI out on or off.
Lights: On, Keys (key lights only) or Off.

keys.label: The scale: lit keys are in it; press to add or remove that note (every octave)

tips: Eight pieces, each its own key, tempo and sound: Garden, Departures, Voices, Afternoon, Night Bus, Shoreline, Glass, Tides.
Hold any button (but PLAY) for a second: a card explains what it does.
The root note always stays, and the scale keeps at least three notes.
Editing the scale with the keys turns the mode into Custom; ALGORITHM loads a full mode again.
It autosaves a few seconds after a change, but only while resting (PLAY off). A dot on screen means unsaved changes.
While frozen (REC), EDIT's chord change waits until you thaw.
Notes on MIDI channel 1 add or remove scale notes like the keys; MIDI clock sets the tempo (EXT).
Hold OCT- and OCT+ for 5 seconds for update mode; let go early to cancel.
checked: Archive amb-1.3.tar.gz from thefirmwarehub.com/src, folder fm1-amb-1.3 (base/ submodule is empty in the archive).
Pages and knobs: app/ui.c VIEW_BTN (HOME ENV ARP LFO SEQ FX GLO = Garden Pad Bells Bass Pulse Space Setup), VIEW_KNOB, KNOB_LABEL.
Buttons: ui.c button(): EDIT en_next (dsp/amb.c C_NEXT: on the bar while playing, at once at rest), PLAY en_play on press, REC en_freeze toggle, OCT-/OCT+ P_BOCT -2..+2, SAVE project_save.
Buttons act on release except PLAY (input()); SAVE held > RESET_HOLD 1500 ms: project_piece_reset + mark_dirty (not saved).
Encoders: input(): SELECT pages without wrap, HOME+SELECT tempo (P_TEMPO 30-120); ALGORITHM set_mode (8 modes, wraps); PRESETS set_piece (8 pieces, dsp/amb.c PIECES[]).
Keys: input() toggle_note((5+i)%12), key 0 = F3; root stays ('THE ROOT STAYS'), min 3 notes ('3 NOTES AT LEAST'); mode_name() shows Custom when pool differs.
Help cards: help_tick()/help_lines(), HELP_HOLD 900 ms, none for PLAY and SEL; OCT cards mention OCT-+OCT+ 5 s update mode.
Autosave: autosave() AUTOSAVE_QUIET 4000 ms, only when !en_playing and pad faded; header dot for dirty (manual).
Freeze: dsp/amb.c line 916 chord change waits while frozen; reverb input muted and decay held (pl_decay 0.9995).
Param ranges/text: dsp/amb.c PARAMS[], en_param_text() (Drift 20 s..5 min, Echo time 1/4. .. 4 bars, Tune -50..50, Lights Off/On/Keys in ui.c knob_text).
MIDI in: ui.c midi_in(): status 0x90 only (channel 1) toggles scale notes; clock/start/continue/stop to en_clock.
Starts growing at power-on: ui_init() en_play(1); project_load() at app_init.
unsure: MIDI out channels (pad 1, bells 2, bass 3, pulse 10) from the manual only, not traced in the engine; left out.

Calibration (OCT- + OCT+ at power-on), CRASH screen and SAFE MODE (PLAY to retry) live in fm1-base, which the archive does not contain; only update mode is confirmed (help card text), so there is no Recovery section.
Whether Lights is per piece or shared: manual says shared (proj.leds sits outside the piece slots), not deeply traced.
MIDI over the TRS jack in (manual) not traced in fm1-base.
